content: Melvin-Koushki continues that the ancient philosophers on one hand and Ibn Turka and his lettrist colleagues on the other thus stand equal to giants such as Pythagoras, Socrates and Euclid, and that it is their destiny, heralded by a recent celestial conjunction, to actualize the occult prophetic legacy from their position at the beginning of the ninth Islamic century. He ends the section with the question whether this is not rather to 'reactualize'.
refers_to_primary: Ibn Turka, R. Shaqq-i Qamar u Bayān-i Sāʿat
